title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Joshua 12: the kings struck east and west of the Jordan, from Sihon and Og to the list of thirty-one.

questions.text: East of the Jordan, the land Israel possessed stretched from the valley of the Arnon to where?
questions.explanation: The land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise ran from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

questions.text: Where did Sihon king of the Amorites live?
questions.explanation: Sihon king of the Amorites lived in Heshbon and ruled from Aroer.

questions.text: Which river is named as the border of the children of Ammon?
questions.explanation: Sihon ruled half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon.

questions.text: What other name does the text give for the sea of the Arabah?
questions.explanation: The text speaks of the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea.

questions.text: Og king of Bashan was of the remnant of which people?
questions.explanation: The text calls Og king of Bashan one of the remnant of the Rephaim.

questions.text: To whom did Moses give the land of these eastern kings?
questions.explanation: Moses gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

answers.text: The Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh
The tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Simeon
The tribes of Ephraim, Issachar, and Zebulun
The tribes of Levi, Dan, and Naphtali

questions.text: West of the Jordan, the land stretched from Baal Gad to which mountain?
questions.explanation: Joshua and Israel struck the kings west of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak.

questions.text: The king of Ai is listed, and Ai is described as being beside which place?
questions.explanation: The list names the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel.

questions.text: Where was Jokneam, whose king is in the list?
questions.explanation: The list names the king of Jokneam in Carmel.

questions.text: What total number of kings does the list give?
questions.explanation: The list ends with the king of Tirzah and says all the kings were thirty-one.
